page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.6xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine provisioned on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by a 2.7 GHz Intel Xeon 8369B processor featuring an x86_64 architecture. The server provides 24 vCPUs mapped across 12 physical cores with 2 threads per core, backed by dedicated CPU allocation. Cache allocation includes 48 KB of L1 data cache, 1 MB of L2 cache, and 48 MB of shared L3 cache. Instruction set extensions include AVX, AVX-512F, and AVX-512 VNNI, along with hardware-assisted cryptographic acceleration via AES, VAES, and SHA-NI.

The system is equipped with 192.0 GB of RAM, offering a high 1:8 ratio of 8.0 GB of memory per vCPU. It does not include any GPU accelerators, and local storage is listed as None, meaning persistent storage must be attached over the network. Network throughput is backed by a 12 Gbps baseline bandwidth configuration. Benchmark measurements confirm standard sustained throughput across memory operations, reaching 1263.88 GB/sec in small-block cached read tests and 129.12 GB/sec in uncached 256 MB reads, alongside 62.93 GB/sec for uncached write operations.

Compute and execution benchmarks show balanced mid-tier throughput across multi-core tests, yielding a PassMark CPU score of 29229.28 and a multi-core Geekbench score of 11384.0. In synthetic application benchmarks, it achieved 23.5 million operations per second on Redis SET tasks and 27.99 GB/sec in static web serving. Additionally, LLM inference on small models reached 283.7 tokens per second for text generation, placing it in the upper quartile for lightweight models, while medium 7B models sustain 14.18 tokens per second.

Due to its high memory density relative to core count and lack of integrated local storage, ecs.r7.6xlarge represents a cost-efficient profile for memory-bound workloads requiring substantial RAM without paying for unused GPU silicon or dedicated local NVMe drives. Primary operational profiles include in-memory databases like Redis or Memcached, large relational database engines, real-time analytics, and caching clusters.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.6xlarge is a memory-optimized instance featuring 24 dedicated vCPUs (12 physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8369B processor at 2.7 GHz) and 192.0 GB of RAM, maintaining an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio. Built on x86_64 architecture with KVM virtualization, it includes AVX-512 and cryptographic hardware extensions. The configuration lacks GPUs and local storage, relying on external network volumes while providing 12 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Benchmarks demonstrate solid mid-range compute capabilities with a PassMark CPU score of 29229.28, strong uncached memory bandwidth of 129.12 GB/sec read, and 23.5 million operations per second in Redis SET workloads. It serves as an efficient compute-to-RAM platform for in-memory databases, large caching layers, and enterprise memory-intensive applications.
